questions.q: INAV 9.1.0, a fixed wing. `led 3 12,7::AIW:0`, the default palette and `mode_color`. The aircraft is armed, the roll stick is to the left beyond the deadband. What does the LED show?
options: Steady blue: it has x ≥ 8, and to the left only the LEDs with x < 8 blink
Blue with orange blinking: on a fixed wing the `I` overlay reacts to roll in either direction
Steady green: the `A` function takes special color 0 while armed
Steady orange: the `I` overlay overrides the base function
questions.explain: `A` while armed is special color 1 (BLUE by default). On a fixed wing the indicator looks only at roll: to the left the `I` LEDs with x < 8 blink, to the right — those with x ≥ 8. The LED has x = 12, and it does not blink on a left roll.

questions.q: `mode_color 6 1 2` is entered in the INAV 9.1.0 CLI. What changed?
options: The arm color became red
The “east” color of the LOITER mode became red
The “east” color of the HORIZON mode became red
Nothing: a parse error
questions.explain: In 9.1.0 mode 6 is LOITER, and indexes 0…5 are the directions N, E, S, W, U, D. The special colors (disarmed, armed, GPS) are mode 7; in 8.0.1 they were mode 6, hence the trap when moving a config.

questions.q: What color does `color 14 30,0,128` set in INAV?
options: Orange at half brightness
Almost white with an orange tint
Dark gray
Yellow at full brightness
questions.explain: H = 30 is orange, S = 0 is a pure color (the saturation is inverted: 255 would give white), V = 128 is half brightness.

questions.q: An F7 board, the elevon servos on S3 and S4 (both on TIM3), no other servo outputs. The config has `feature LED_STRIP` and `timer_output_mode 2 LED`. What happens?
options: The servos work, the strip moves to S3
Both TIM3 outputs are skipped in the assignment, arming is blocked by the `PWMOUT` flag
The strip and the servos work together: they have different channels of one timer, there is no conflict
The firmware clears `feature LED_STRIP` at boot by itself
questions.explain: With LED_STRIP enabled every output on a timer that has a channel with the LED flag is skipped (`checkPwmTimerConflicts`). No outputs are left for the servos — `PWMOUT`. The firmware clears the feature only for a timer shared with SoftSerial.

questions.q: Which numbers do you put in `pinio_box1` and in `aux` so that PINIO1 follows the USER1 mode in INAV 9.1.0?
options: 37 and 37
40 and 40
47 and 47
37 in `pinio_box1`, 47 in `aux`
questions.explain: Both `pinio_box` and `aux` take the permanent id: USER1 = 47 (USER2 = 48, USER3 = 57, USER4 = 58). 37 is the internal `boxId` of USER1, and as a permanent id it is SERVO AUTOTRIM. 40 is USER1 in Betaflight.

questions.q: How can an INAV 9.1.0 logic condition switch PINIO2?
options: With operation 21 (Set IO Port): operand A is the PINIO number, operand B is the level 0 or 1
With operation 52 (LED Pin PWM) with the value 100
With operation 38, by overriding the channel that carries the range of the mode from `pinio_box2`
It cannot: PINIO is controlled only with a switch
questions.explain: There is no direct operation. Operation 38 overrides the value of an RC channel, the `aux` range on it activates the USER mode, and PINIO follows the mode. Operation 21 writes to an I²C IO expander, operation 52 controls the LED pin, not PINIO.

questions.q: The shutter rules: the remainder of the trip distance divided by 30 m, the window “remainder < 3”, a pulse on the rising edge. A 600 m leg starts at a distance of d₀ = 905 m. How many shots?
questions.explain: n = ⌊(905 + 600) / 30⌋ − ⌊905 / 30⌋ = 50 − 30 = 20. The shots are tied to the distance since arming (930, 960, … 1500 m), not to the start of the leg.

questions.q: A quadcopter on DShot, `dshot_beeper_enabled = ON`, the config has `beeper -RX_LOST`. After a flight and a disarm the radio is off. What do you hear (INAV 9.1.0)?
options: The beeper is silent, the motors beep once a second
The beeper beeps, the motors are silent
Both the beeper and the motors are silent
Both the beeper and the motors beep
questions.explain: In 9.1.0 the DShot beacon is not sent on conditions disabled with the `beeper` command (in 8.0.1 the motors would beep). By disabling RX_LOST you lose both lost-model signals.

questions.q: The `BEEPER` mode is on from a switch, `feature GPS`, a fix, 8 satellites. What sounds, and with what cycle?
options: 8 beeps, a 1.6 s cycle
8 beeps, a 1.2 s cycle
10 beeps, a 1.9 s cycle
the short RX_SET beeps without counting
questions.explain: n = min(8, 10) = 8; T = 50·8 + 100·7 + 500 = 1600 ms. The count runs with a fix and at least 5 satellites, with a maximum of 10 beeps; otherwise RX_SET sounds.

questions.q: What does INAV 9.1.0 have for controlling a camera?
options: A distance-based shooting interval setting and a separate “take a picture” command at a mission waypoint
The CAMERA CONTROL 1–3 modes for RunCam buttons and mission user actions as logic operands
The `LIGHTS` mode and the `failsafe_lights*` settings in any official build
A separate CLI command `beacon` for the DShot beacon
questions.explain: The firmware has no ready-made camera trigger: a distance-based shutter is assembled from logic conditions. LIGHTS is hidden under `USE_LIGHTS`, which no board defines; the `beacon` command is from Betaflight.
